description: Magasinstatistikk is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Norges vassdrags- og energidirektorat (nve). Ukentlig statistikk av energilagring i norske vannmagasiner --- Formål: Fyllingsgraden forteller energiinnholdet i magasinene, og dermed ressurssituasjonen i kraftmarkedet. Denne informasjonen kan brukes blant annet til produksjons-beregninger. Coverage: Norges vassdrags- og energidirektorat (nve). The publisher named on the listing is Norges vassdrags- og energidirektorat (nve). Its keywords include vann, vannmagasin, energi. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
